evidence: the-locale-setting-works: files/locale/locale (whole file, sha256 26c9d6e9...) is LANG="en_US.UTF-8" / LC_ALL="en_US.UTF-8"; manifest 26-32 sources it to /etc/default/locale. The probe compares the node file's sha256 to that exact baseline digest and sources it in a clean env, requiring both variables and no locale error on stderr; applied run saw the digest and LANG/LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8, clean node saw Ubuntu's link with LC_ALL unset

the-syslog-file-is-left-alone-by-default: manifest 56-63 declares File[$syslog_filepath] only inside if ($customize_syslog_mode); variant default runs with params default (customize_syslog_mode false, the class default and node_base's default at node_base.pp:9,108-110). The probe proves the class applied (mypython -> /usr/bin/python3) and counts File[/var/log/syslog|/var/log/messages] in the node's cached catalog JSON: 0 observed after apply, as the code produces

the-local-tree-exists: manifest 10-24 declares the five lookup()ed dirs (localdir, bin, etc, backup, pkgsdir) ensure directory root:root mode 0644; Puppet adds x to directories for each r bit, so 755 is what the code yields. The probe stats /opt/puppet-infrastructure and its bin/etc/backup/pkgsdir (the lab Hiera's filesystem::* values) and observed root:root 755 for all five after apply, nothing on the clean node

purpose covered: Purpose (basic filesystem of non-desktop machines: local tree, locale fix for ssh sessions, mypython link, optional syslog owner/mode) matches the class header and baseline code. Every outcome-table row maps to a check that probes it behaviourally: tree dirs and ownership; the locale file sourced as PAM would, with no locale error; mypython executed and reporting Python 3; syslog mode drifted to 0644 by hand and restored to syslog:adm 0640 by the node's next agent run (rc 2, 1 changed); variant default (customize_syslog_mode false) shows no syslog File in the catalog; variant rhel on rhel9 shows /var/log/messages moved from root:root 600 to root:root 640 and mypython -> /usr/bin/python3. No uncovered rows; nothing the lab can exercise is left untested (the locale file's own owner/mode 0644 is not probed, but its content and effect are, which is the stated purpose).
